parts.title: Through the Gate
parts.text: Jomo, Nell, and Arjun went to the zoo with their class. The animals could **roam** in wide, open yards. First they saw a lion on a big rock. He looked **majestic** with his thick mane. Then he gave a loud **roar**.

parts.title: Big and Strong
parts.text: An elephant began to **lumber** past the fence. Its legs were big and **mighty**. Its size would **astonish** anyone. Near the pond, a hippo chose to **wallow** in the cool mud.

parts.title: More Friends
parts.text: Arjun counted each black **stripe** on a zebra. A turtle began to **plod** along the path. A big gorilla let out a deep **bellow**. Arjun was **fearless** and waved hello. At the end, a bear stretched out to **lounge** in the sun.

parts.title: Home Again
parts.text: The zoo closed at five. The friends rode the bus home, tired and happy. They told their families about every animal.
